method: Two-axis draft: operation families and scientific contexts. Prior fine analytical requirements survive as tags; direct family migrations remain provisional except where question-level decomposition is recorded. Broad context labels without a supported narrower mapping are retained as review gaps. Original instructions and verifier proposals are preserved.
eligibility_policy: Include source tasks whose scientific purpose admits a clear executable framing, even when the original scorer is an LLM. Freeze missing conventions or scope narrative interpretation to computed evidence. Exclude a replacement objective, unavailable source instruction or unbounded subjective synthesis.
counting: Count each eligible record once per operation family and scientific context. Fine tags do not multiply counts. Annotation gaps, overlapping releases and repeated source protocols remain explicit; these counts do not establish validated coverage.
